list.title: Advanced MERN Stack: Real-Time Data Sync with MongoDB Change Streams
list.subheading: Going Beyond Polling - Unveiling True Live Experiences in Modern MERN Architectures
list.excerpt: Unlock the full potential of your MERN stack apps by implementing real-time data sync with MongoDB Change Streams. Discover how to ditch unreliable polling, architect resilient live features, and avoid the common pitfalls in true production-grade solutions. Honest, actionable, and packed with illustrative code samples.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Building a Simple MERN Stack Application: Step-by-Step Tutorial
list.subheading: A brutally honest guide to MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js-without the tutorial fluff
list.excerpt: Learn how to build a simple MERN stack application step by step using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. This brutally honest tutorial explains what actually matters, what most guides get wrong, and how to avoid common MERN pitfalls while building a real-world foundation.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Deploying MERN Stack Apps on AWS with Elastic Beanstalk: The Raw Truth No One Tells You
list.subheading: From Dev Nightmare to Production Reality - A No-BS Guide to Launching Your MERN App Without Losing Your Sanity
list.excerpt: Discover the honest pros, pitfalls, and step-by-step battle-tested process for deploying full-stack MERN applications on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Perfect for developers tired of tutorials that skip the real-world headaches like environment failures and database disconnects. Updated for 2026 best practices.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Exploring Alternatives to JWT: Secure Token Strategies for Modern Web Applications
list.subheading: Beyond JSON Web Tokens: When, Why, and How to Choose Better Token-Based Authentication Methods
list.excerpt: Discover top alternatives to JWT for authentication, including opaque tokens, PASETO, and session-based auth. Learn their strengths, weaknesses, and implementation tips for secure apps.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Connecting React and Node.js Applications: A Practical Guide
list.subheading: A step-by-step guide to connecting a React frontend to a Node.js backend.
list.excerpt: Learn how to connect your React application to a Node.js backend with this practical guide. We'll cover everything from making API requests to handling data.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Implementing JWT Authentication and Authorization in MERN Stack Applications
list.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Secure User Management Using JSON Web Tokens in MERN
list.excerpt: Learn how to implement JWT-based authentication and authorization in MERN stack applications. This guide covers user registration, login, protected routes, and role-based access control with practical code examples.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Securing Next.js Applications with JWT: A Comprehensive Guide to Authentication and Authorization
list.subheading: Implementing robust JWT-based authentication and authorization in Next.js for secure and scalable web applications
list.excerpt: Learn how to implement JWT authentication and authorization in Next.js, including best practices, middleware integration, and secure token management using JavaScript and TypeScript.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Displaying Data vs. Data Integrity in MERN Full Stack Development: A Comprehensive Guide
list.subheading: Navigating the Balancing Act in Modern Web Applications
list.excerpt: Uncover the importance of balancing data display and data integrity in MERN stack development. Dive deep into strategies for optimizing user experience while ensuring robust data security and integrity in your web applications.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Demystifying Encryption: Understanding HMAC, SHA-256, and RSA in Modern Applications
list.subheading: A Practical Guide to Cryptographic Primitives for Developers and Architects
list.excerpt: Explore how HMAC, SHA-256, and RSA encryption work, their practical applications, security strengths, and how to implement them using JavaScript and TypeScript.
list.author: Paul Serban
